Messages.Author: The Cadaverous Verger
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> and speaking of the checklist, what the heck is a "Bloodstorm of
> Chorazin", in the RPG? or at least what's Chorazin? it sounds a bit
> like some medication i might have once been on...

Chorazin was Shaitan's palace which he built in "north of Galilee", over
the tomb of Namtaru (a ridiculously powerful demon-thing). Later
abandoned, but rediscovered by Azaneal during the 11th century with the
help of some Lasombra.

Unfortunately they read some really bad writing on the walls of
Namtaru's tomb (written by Namtaru in his sleep) and "the darkness of
Chorazin" possessed them all and they killed each other -- except for
Azaneal. And even he went stark raving mad, splitting the bloodline into
two contesting factions.

--CV

And from White Wolf source materials there are several baali that come
after Maureen in the alphabets. Here are some of possible vampires.

1st guess:
Nergal and Moloch are the two named children of Saulot who spawned the
bloodline. According to the mythos Nergal has perhaps used also names
Shaitan, Adriel and Huitzilopochtli. This could make one guess that the
TBA vampire could be another big gun Baali:
Moloch
Baali 11, DAI OBF PRE XXX XXX XXX
+bleed, at least decent special.

2nd guess:
From the book Kindred Most Wanted we can find a Baali named Petaniqua.
She was mother of Alexander the Great, embraced by Cybele (already in the
set) after his son ascended to the throne. She is also known by names
Myrtale and Olympias. She has associated herself with a tribe of wyrm
infested werewolves known as Black Spiral Dancers and with the Sabbat.
She could also be a Malkavian antitribu. Her possible Baali origins are
quite hazy:
Petaniqua, The Black Eyes of the Wyrm
Baali 9, DAI DEM THA AUS obf
Sabbat. Red List. ???.

3rd guess:
A childe of Moloch named in Clanbook Baali:
Tanit
Baali 10, DAI OBF PRE ??? ??? ???
???.

4th guess:
I might be completely wrong and it's just another Baali or maybe even
that Blood Brother guy that people have talked about.
